dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent over Kwakwani town along the Berbice river as of 07 June 2021, Region 10, Guyana
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20210520GUY** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters along the Berbice river in Upper Demerara-Berbice Region of Guyana as observed from RCM-2 radar image acquired on 07 June 2021 at 22:21 UTC. Within the analyzed area of about 38,000 ha, a total of about 48 ha of lands were observed as flooded. This is a preliminary analysis that has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT. Important note: Flood analysis from radar images may underestimate the presence of standing waters in built-up areas and densely vegetated areas due to backscattering properties of the radar signal.
